``ASK`` is the default and means the risk-level rule decides; ``ALLOW``

absent from a policy is ``ASK``.

UpdateAgentRequest.description:
A partial update. Every field optional; omitted fields are untouched.

``None`` is meaningful for `provider` and `model` (back to inheriting), so
`model_fields_set` separates "sent as null" from "not sent".
UpdateAgentRequest.title: UpdateAgentRequest

UpdateScheduleRequest.description: A partial update; fields left out are untouched.
UpdateScheduleRequest.title: UpdateScheduleRequest

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
A partial update. Every field optional; omitted fields are untouched.

Unknown fields are rejected, not dropped: Pydantic's default turns a
misspelled setting into a `200 OK` that changed nothing. This model must
list every field of :class:`~agentspace.store.settings.WorkspaceSettings`
(they differ in bounds and optionality, so it cannot be the same class),
and `test_every_workspace_setting_can_be_patched` keeps the two in step.
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest

UpdateSpaceRequest.description: A partial update. ``None`` means "inherit", so `model_fields_set` tells it from "not sent".
UpdateSpaceRequest.title: UpdateSpaceRequest

WorkspaceSettings.title: WorkspaceSettings

get.description: Every definition, enabled or not: this backs the roster editor.

patch.description: Apply a partial update. A built-in is editable; only the delete path is guarded.

post.description: A copy of one definition on another space's roster.

get.description: Every approval still waiting for an answer, oldest first.

post.description:
Allow or deny a pending call, and release the agent waiting on it.

404 for an unknown id; 409 for one already settled, so a second window's
click reads as "already answered" rather than "gone".
Fetch the pinned App Server runtime once; idempotent while it downloads.

get.description: Month-to-date spend against the cap; ``space_id`` adds that space's share beside it.

post.description: Start a scripted run so the event spine can be exercised without a model.

get.description: Liveness probe, carrying the launch tag so the shell knows it is us.

Recent runs, newest first: what the run picker reads. ``origin`` keeps
only the runs started from the window, by a schedule, or from Discord.

post.description:
Create a run and start the orchestrator on it.

Returns as soon as the row exists; the client watches the run over SSE.
Starting it is :class:`~agentspace.orchestrator.launcher.RunLauncher`'s
job, shared with the chat channels.

delete.description:
Remove a finished run, its events and its approvals. Its spend stays.

A run that has not ended is a 409: the log must never be deleted from
under an orchestrator still appending to it. A run this process is still
driving is refused even if its row just turned terminal, since the
orchestrator lets go a moment after writing the status. See
:meth:`~agentspace.events.store.EventStore.delete_run` for what is kept.

post.description:
Ask a run to stop.

202: the run stops at its next deadline check and writes `run.cancelled`
itself, so the row returned here may still say `running`. A finished run,
or one this process is not driving, is a 409.

get.description:
Server-sent events for one run, resumable via `Last-Event-ID`.

``after_seq`` is the same cursor for a first connection, which cannot
carry the header. On a reconnect the header wins if it is further along.
The event log as a plain array, for the dashboard's history load, tests and `curl`.

schema.title: Response Get Run Events Runs  Run Id  Events History Get

post.description: The cadence in words and its next few times, for the editor before a save.
Start this schedule's run right now, leaving its next time as it was.

patch.description:
Apply a partial settings update.

Validation failures are 400s carrying `{message, field}`.

get.description:
What can be selected, and which models are priced, grouped per provider.

The dropdowns read this rather than a list that would drift from `pricing.py`.

post.description:
Check the current settings can build a provider, without calling the model.

The dashboard's pre-flight: the refusal a run would get, shown before
Start. With ``space_id`` the space's effective settings are checked.

get.description: Every space, archived ones included: their runs are still viewable.

post.description:
Create a space and seed its roster.

The seed is its own write after the row exists, so a partial copy leaves
a space the user can see and fix.

delete.description: Delete an empty space and its agents. 409 for the default, or one with runs.

post.description: Add the starter roles an existing roster lacks. Safe to press twice.

schema.title: Response Seed Space Spaces  Space Id  Seed Post

get.description: The tool catalogue with each tool's risk level, for the editor's checkboxes.

A month of model calls from the ledger: totals, by model, space and day, and the costliest runs.

``period`` is ``YYYY-MM`` and defaults to this month; ``space_id`` narrows
to one space's runs. Read from the same rows the cap is enforced on, so the
report and the meter cannot disagree.
